gap: No result ChatGPT got states that a separate inverter + 48 V rack-battery home backup set needs a 160 A DC breaker and a 250 A bus bar between the batteries and the inverter, or that Sun Gold Power's SPH6548P inverter, two SG48100P batteries, that breaker and that bus bar all fit in one sungoldpower.com cart for $3,166 (6.5 kW, 120/240 V, 10.24 kWh). Sun Gold Power's own SGM-6510M kit includes the same breaker and bus bar.
standout_why: I compared against ChatGPT's answer text and the titles and URLs of its 17 results. I did not open tesla.com/powerwall, the Powerwall 3 datasheets or ecoflow.com/us/delta-pro-ultra; I spent the call budget on store pages. The answer only says separate battery + inverter systems 'require careful electrical design and compatible equipment'. It names no DC breaker, bus bar or battery count, and no single-store cart for that route. All its results are about Tesla Powerwall 3 or EcoFlow DELTA Pro Ultra, which are all-in-one units, so they are unlikely to cover a 48 V DC breaker or bus bar for a separate inverter and battery set. That last point is my inference, since I did not open them. I scored this 2, not 3, because the rival pages were not read in full.
kit_items: Inverter/charger: Sun Gold Power SPH6548P 6.5 kW 48 V. The store listing says one unit gives 'Split phase (120V/240V) or Single phase (120v) output', is UL 1741 by ETL, has a 140 A battery charger and 2 MPPT inputs, and costs $1,035.

Battery: Sun Gold Power SG48100P 51.2 V 100 Ah server-rack LiFePO4, x2 = 10.24 kWh, UL1973/UL9540A. The store lists CAN/RS485/RS232 and names SunGoldPower among compatible inverters. Use the 2-pack SKU ($1,953), which is $9 less than two singles.
DC protection: Sun Gold Power 160 A DC breaker ($89). It is the battery breaker in the maker's own 6.5 kW kit (SGM-6510M).
DC combining: Sun Gold Power 250 A 48 VDC bus bar pair with cover ($89). It joins two batteries in parallel, as in SGM-6510M.

Alternative all-in-one cart: BLUETTI Apex 300 (3,840 W, 2,764.8 Wh, 120/240 V) + B300K + Apex 300 Home Integration Kit (Reliance sub panel, 50 A inlet). The Apex 300 page says it ships in late January.

carts.bundle_sku: SGM-6510M Off-Grid Solar Kit, $4,703 (https://sungoldpower.com/products/off-grid-solar-kit-6500w-48vdc-120-240vac-10-24kwh-powerwall-lithium-battery-6-x-370-watts-solar-panels-sgm-6510m). It has the same inverter, 2 batteries, 160 A breaker and 250 A bus bar, plus six 370 W panels, a 25 A PV breaker, 1/0 AWG battery cables, a 50 ft PV cable and brackets. That is $1,537 more than the $3,166 four-item cart, so for battery backup without solar the separate items are cheaper. There is no solar-free SKU of this set. No free gift was listed in the store search data.

items: BLUETTI Apex 300 Home Integration Kit (single Apex 300) | https://www.bluettipower.com/products/apex-300-home-integration-kit | $699.00 | 2026-11-13
carts.bundle_sku: 'Apex 300 + B300K + Home Backup Kit (Single Apex 300)', $3,199 (https://www.bluettipower.com/products/apex-300-b300k-home-backup-kit-single-apex-300), with a free Kid's T-shirt. That is $98 less than the three items above ($3,297), so use the bundle if its kit is the same Home Integration Kit; the bundle page does not list what the kit contains. The plain 'Apex 300 + B300K' bundle costs $2,599, which is $1 more than buying the two separately ($2,598). For two batteries, Apex 300 plus the '2*B300K for Apex 300/200' SKU costs $3,498.99, which is $190.01 less than the 'Apex 300+2*B300K' bundle at $3,689.
